title: LLMs as a Jury: Cross-Model Consensus Can Outperform Process Reward Models for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.10139v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Selecting the correct answer from a pool of candidate reasoning chains is the engine of test-time scaling, yet the standard selectors each carry a cost: self-consistency inherits the errors of the single model it resamples, and trained reward models need labeled data and transfer poorly off-distribution. We study a third signal, free at inference time: cross-model consensus, the degree to which independently trained models, each solving the problem once, agree on a final answer. We treat the panel as an LLM-jury, in which the verification signal is the structure of agreement itself, with no model scoring another's work. Across seven benchmarks it selects correct answers better than self-consistency and far better than a model scoring its own candidates: on competition math it closes the entire gap to an oracle selector, while self-scoring closes almost none. The mechanism is error decorrelation: independently trained models err

translated_title: 大语言模型作为陪审团：跨模型共识在推理任务上可超越过程奖励模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：从候选推理链池中选择正确答案是测试时扩展的核心机制，但标准选择器各有代价：自一致性继承了其重采样单一模型的错误，而训练奖励模型需要标注数据且在分布外泛化能力差。我们研究第三种信号，在推理时免费可用：跨模型共识，即独立训练的模型各自解决一次问题后，对最终答案的一致程度。我们将专家组视为一个“大语言模型陪审团”，其中验证信号是共识结构本身，没有模型对另一个模型的工作进行评分。在七个基准测试中，该方法比自一致性选择正确答案更准确，且远优于模型自我评分候选答案：在竞赛数学上，它完全弥合了与神谕选择器的差距，而自我评分几乎未缩小差距。其机制是错误去相关：独立训练的模型出错模式不同。
tldr: 本文提出利用跨模型共识作为推理时验证信号，通过多个独立训练模型对答案的一致性选择正确答案，在竞赛数学上达到接近神谕选择器的性能，其核心机制是错误去相关。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using cross-model consensus as a free inference-time verification signal, where agreement among independently trained models selects correct answers, achieving near-oracle performance on competition math via error decorrelation.
